configs.name: rules-baseline
configs.description: Rule-based planner, default limits (3 rounds, 24 tool calls, stop at 0.75)

configs.name: rules-single-round
configs.description: Triage round only: no targeted follow-up evidence

configs.name: rules-eager-stop
configs.description: Stops as soon as the leading hypothesis reaches 0.55

configs.name: rules-no-knowledge
configs.description: Ablation: knowledge base / incident history tools unavailable

scenarios.title: Orders deploy introduces an N+1 query and saturates the DB pool
Redis becomes unreachable
Upstream payments provider returns errors
Network latency on the path to PostgreSQL
Feature flag leaks DB connections until the pool is exhausted
Failed api-gateway canary keeps serving traffic
api-gateway deploy adds an unbounded cache (memory leak)
Worker deploy breaks shipping labels; the queue backs up
Shipping-label provider slowness backs up the queue
Traffic surge beyond capacity
Query-plan regression without a deployment
N+1 deploy while logs and database telemetry are unavailable
Redis outage while infrastructure monitoring is down
Payments provider failure, orders deploy shipped after the onset
Gateway errors after a gateway release, caused by an orders config change
Redis slowness and payments errors at the same time
Gateway memory leak deploy plus an unrelated worker backlog
Vague slowness report with nothing wrong
Question blames a deploy that changed nothing
Database network latency with a misleading worker config change
Redis outage one minute after an unrelated gateway release
Payments provider completely down
N+1 deploy while metrics and logs backends are flaky
orders-service returns 500s after a release (no resource symptom)
Redis slow (not down): catalog and carts slower
